title: BotDeskLeaseCreateRequest
description: bot.desk-lease-create-request@1 (the Desks plan's D6): the body of POST /api/v1/machines/{id}/desk-leases on OpenVibe.Bot (capability bot.desk.session), answered 201 with bot.desk-lease@1. DESK is the name Run chose for the session (unique per session); a desk already leased to another session, or running for the machine's owner, is refused 409 bot.desk_busy, and a repeat for the same session answers its lease (200). A machine with no room (its max_desks) is refused 409 bot.machine_busy, one that is offline 409 bot.device_offline, and one the person may not use 404 bot.device_not_found.

kind.description: browser (a headless browser driven over its pipe) or desktop (0.433.0: a whole desktop, a display with a window manager, a browser and a terminal, on a desk host that lends desktops and keeps each one in its own sandbox; driven with screen and input only). A machine that does not run that kind (its describe: desk.kinds; on a shared host, what its owner lends and Bot's shared_desktops) is refused 409 bot.kind_unavailable.

origins.description: The session's exact browser origins, fixed for this lease. Empty allows no network origin; absent keeps the legacy policy. A shared desk that cannot enforce the list is refused.
